oracle.name: Power Pages
oracle.scope: Two signed-in runs on 2026-11-26 (k1, k2) of the same edit basic form served under /de-DE/ (site languages en-US and de-DE, MultiLanguage/DisplayLanguageCodeInURL true), for a row re-seeded with 1.5 in decimal, float and money and 1500 in a whole number: the Dataverse read-back after a native postback of 1234,5 or 1234.5 in the decimal, float and money boxes. Establishes the de-DE number parsing of the native form; not the served box formatting (one of the two loads served a cached earlier value) or validation messages.
